errorRules.message: Invalid or missing Subconscious API key. Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}
Subconscious returned HTTP 429: rate limited due to too many requests or tokens per minute.

instructions: 1. Visit https://subconscious.dev/platform and sign up or sign in (the quickstart, https://docs.subconscious.dev/quickstart, describes signing up on the platform and generating an API key from the dashboard)
2. Create an API key at https://subconscious.dev/platform/api-keys and copy it (https://docs.subconscious.dev/ways-to-use/cloud-api says API keys are created and managed from the dashboard)

3. Pricing is at https://www.subconscious.dev/pricing (monthly token plans and usage-based per-token pricing); the cloud-API page says 'Usage is billed per token.' and 'Credits are added from your dashboard'
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint at https://api.subconscious.dev/v1. The vendor overview (https://docs.subconscious.dev/overview) says 'Our API is compatible with both the OpenAI Completions and Anthropic Messages APIs'; this entry uses the OpenAI-format /chat/completions route. Verification level: docs- and roster-verified, not live-verified (evidence.liveMatrix is null). Checks made on 2026-09-29 were unauthenticated GET requests to /v1/models (HTTP 200, 4 models) and /v1/chat/completions (HTTP 405, allow: POST); no key was used and no POST was sent. The OpenAPI spec (https://docs.subconscious.dev/api-reference/openapi.json) lists statuses 400, 401 ('Unauthorized because of a missing or invalid API key'), 429 ('Rate limited due to too many requests or tokens per minute') and 500, so errorRules match on status. The spec says of response_format: 'Currently unsupported. The request may accept this field, but it is ignored and does not constrain the model output to JSON or a schema.' tools, toolsWithStreaming, structuredOutput, structuredOutputWithTools and thinking are declared false and were not probed with a key. models.defaultContextWindow (200000), models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (4096) and the vision value (false) of the three catalog models are placeholders the vendor does not publish per model. billingPolicy no-free-tier is the schema's required field value, not a vendor statement.
